subject: OptiScale multi-account rebate & AWS private-offer carveout request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@optiscale.com>, procurement@optiscale.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OptiScale multi-account rebate request - private offer carveout

Hi Marcus / Ben,

Quick ask: OptiScale (contact John Carter) is lining up a cross-division purchase that combines three separate AWS accounts under a 12-month committed contract. They want to buy through an AWS Private Offer (required by their procurement) but the combined ARR and SKUs would fall below our published marketplace minimums for the promotional tiering.

Why this matters: they’re a strategic pilot opportunity (large retail customer, potential channel references) and we need to secure listing + co-sell registration on the AWS side to get Sales points. They’re asking if we can make an exception: a tiered rebate (one-time marketplace credit + an upfront discount) that effectively approximates a 15–18% blended discount with an additional $35k co-sell credit to offset marketplace fees.

What I need from Deal Desk: approval path and conditional limits we can offer for a Private Offer (not public listing). Key constraints below — can we make a carveout?
- Term: 12 months
- Total ARR (annualized committed spend): $420,000
- Accounts: 3 accounts (US-only) — see attached SKU breakdown
- Customer asks: 18% upfront discount OR 15% discount + $35k co-sell credit; private-offer required for procurement flow

Attachments: OptiScale_SOW_v1.pdf, OptiScale_SKU_breakdown.xlsx

Quick timing: John is pushing to close the pilot by end of January so they can start onboarding. Appreciate a quick read and guidance on acceptable guardrails we should present.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@optiscale.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OptiScale multi-account rebate request - private offer carveout

Mina — thanks for the details. A few clarifying items before I route for approval:
1) Confirm the $420k is committed ARR (not including professional services). Is billing annual upfront or monthly?
2) Breakdown by account (annualized per-account ARR) — we need to confirm tiering against our rebate bands.
3) Is the customer insisting on marketplace private-offer (DocuSign/PO via AWS) or would they accept a direct Redwood invoice and marketplace registration later? Private-offer flows increase fee exposure and require marketplace listing commitments.
4) Any current Redwood discounts/credits applied previously to these accounts?

If the customer will accept a 15% blended discount + co-sell credit, that’s easier to approve than straight 18% off list. Assuming annual upfront billing and no prior high discounts, we can consider a one-time exception for strategic pilots — but I’ll need Ben to confirm appetite and then finance + legal signoff.

Can you upload the SKU sheet to the HubSpot deal and confirm the ARR per-account? Once I have that I’ll prepare the exception proposal for Ben and route to finance.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@optiscale.com>, procurement@optiscale.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OptiScale multi-account rebate request - private offer carveout

Marcus — thanks. Uploaded the SKU breakout to HubSpot and attached the two files to this thread. Answers inline:
- $420k = committed ARR (annual)
- Billing: annual upfront
- Per-account split (annualized): Account A $220k, Account B $125k, Account C $75k
- No prior discounts on these accounts; standard net-new terms
The customer requires the Private Offer for procurement (PO routing on their side), so they won’t accept a direct invoice. They also need co-sell registration on AWS prior to kickoff.

Proposed compromise we can present: Redwood grants a 15% upfront discount + $35k one-time marketplace credit if OptiScale signs within 10 business days and commits to a joint press reference after a successful pilot. Otherwise we fall back to published marketplace tiers.

DocuSign prep: John asked if we can get the private-offer template started ASAP. I can send the DocuSign once we have internal approval.

John — looping procurement contact (procurement@optiscale.com) for visibility.
Thanks,
Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@optiscale.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 14:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OptiScale multi-account rebate request - private offer carveout

Mina / Marcus — I’m supportive of a one-time pilot exception for OptiScale given the strategic upside and clear joint-marketing ask. Approve up to 15% blended discount + $35k marketplace credit contingent on the following:
- Legal signs the private-offer language (no change to IP or data terms)
- Finance confirms impact to recognition (we should handle the credit as a contra-revenue/mktg credit)
- AWS co-sell registration is completed before kickoff (Marcus, please coordinate with AWS rep)
Marcus — can you draft the exception memo I can sign off on? I want the memo to include deal economics, fallback pricing, and expiration (10 business days). After my sign-off I’ll communicate approval to the customer and ask for DocuSign.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales — US Enterprise, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: John Carter <john.carter@optiscale.com>, procurement@optiscale.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OptiScale multi-account rebate request - private offer carveout

Thanks Ben — I’ll put together the exception memo and route it to Legal (cc: finance). Next steps I’ll own:
- Prepare exception memo for Ben’s signature (includes ARR, per-account split, proposed 15% + $35k credit, fallback tiers, 10-business-day expiry)
- Open legal review thread and attach our standard private-offer template
John / OptiScale procurement: we’ll get the private-offer draft into DocuSign once internal approvals complete. Expect an update from me within 48 hours.
Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/ops/12345/deals/HS-2027-0471), DocuSign prep (https://www.docusign.com/templates/prepare/optiscale-private-offer)
Attachments: OptiScale_SOW_v1.pdf (attached to finance memo), OptiScale_SKU_breakdown.xlsx
—Marcus
